title: What if the faith you think is too small…
paragraphs:
What if the faith you think is too small…
is actually enough to start something unstoppable?

Most people are waiting until they feel “ready.”
But Jesus pointed to a seed.

Sometimes God isn’t asking for big faith.
Just planted faith.
God never asked for huge faith.

Seeds look weak…
until they grow.

Small habits.
Small prayers.
Small obedience.
But the kingdom of God started with something that looked insignificant.
A seed can split rock over time.

Your faith doesn’t need to look impressive.
It just needs to be planted.

Most people quit in the seed stage.
Growth is quieter than we expect.
